purpose: One record per paid or free generation attempt in Dulce Part I, appended to Storage videos/dulce-part1/telemetry/attempts.jsonl and mirrored in the run artifact. Dataset for the Multi-Provider Router.

attemptRecord.shotId: storyboard slot id, e.g. P1-014 (an asset reused in several slots lists every slot in usedInShots)
attemptRecord.sceneType: establishing | tunnel | corridor | control-room | portrait | human+non-human | lab | family | insert | document | graphic
attemptRecord.finalApproved: true when this attempt's output is the one the master uses
attemptRecord.productionMethod: stock | still | ken_burns | parallax | i2v_economy | i2v_hero | v1_recut | graphic
attemptRecord.shotClass: landscape | object | single_human | multi_human | creature | human_creature | laboratory | corridor | graphic | other
attemptRecord.generatedSeconds: seconds produced by the provider (0 for stills)
attemptRecord.acceptedSeconds: seconds of this output used in the final master (summed over the slots it fills)
attemptRecord.failureKind: none | transport (not accepted/charged: at most one retry) | semantic (QA fail: next attempt must change prompt, motion, method or provider, or drop down the ladder)
attemptRecord.qaLayer: L0 planner | L1 local (ffmpeg/opencv: black, freeze, duration, abrupt change, face-count change) | L2 semantic review (humans, creatures, hero shots, L1 flags)

metrics.costPerApprovedShot: sum(costUsd of every attempt for an asset, including failed ones and fallbacks) / number of storyboard slots that asset fills in the final master; reported per asset, per sceneType and per provider
metrics.totalApprovedShots: count of storyboard slots in the final master whose asset has finalApproved=true (reuses of V1 counted separately as zero-cost)
metrics.regenerationRate: (attempts - unique assets attempted) / unique assets attempted
metrics.fallbackRate: assets whose final output is fallbackUsed=approved-still-camera-motion / assets attempted with video
metrics.costPerFinishedVideo: totalGenerationCost for the episode, plus voice characters valued at the plan's per-character rate
metrics.costPerApprovedSecond: sum(costUsd for an asset) / acceptedSeconds of that asset in the final master
metrics.generativeShareOfTimeline: sum(acceptedSeconds where productionMethod in (i2v_economy, i2v_hero)) / final master seconds; also reported including reused V1 generative footage

policy.retry: TRANSPORT failure: at most one retry, only with evidence the job was not accepted or charged. SEMANTIC failure: never repeat the same attempt; change something material (simpler motion or prompt, other method or provider/tier) or step down the ladder. After a second failure: approved still + controlled camera motion. Never regenerate until it passes.
policy.gate: The render only accepts assets whose final approval is recorded by checksum; a FAIL never reaches the master.
policy.preGenerationQA: New images are inspected and approved (limbs, hands, duplicates, identity, clothing, character count, text artifacts, narrative fit) before any image-to-video call; only approved stills may be animated.
